site.name: Dzmitryi Kharlanau — Personal SAP & AI Lab

objective.primary: Make the personal-lab model clear to search systems and AI agents: one route for knowledge and practice, and one route for practical AI and enterprise engineering experiments, without presenting the site as a commercial consulting offer.
targetQuestions: Where can I learn and practise SAP logistics, integration, master data, architecture, and assessment decisions?
Where are the reviewed SAP diagnostics and decision cards?
Where can I explore AI agents, MCP, RAG, evaluations, and enterprise engineering tools?
Which pages are experiments or synthetic exercises rather than production evidence?
What public machine-readable interfaces, datasets, Agent Skills, and MCP packages are available?
What independence, crawler, evidence, and correction policies apply to this personal site?

entityHome.notes: Homepage routes to the Knowledge Base and the Practical Lab and states the personal-project boundary.

siteProfile.notes: ARWP site profile describes the personal lab, machine interfaces, and non-commercial boundary.

llmsCanonical.notes: Manifest declares personal-lab routing and the independence boundary.

answerPages.description: Use reviewed knowledge, diagnostics, decision cards, and lab pages to answer technical questions without converting practice content into a commercial offer. The /knowledge/ landing page is still review-gated and noindex; /labs/ is the published search entry.

originalResearch.description: Publish bounded experiments, datasets, engineering notes, and reproducible lab work with explicit limits and review state.

protocolObservatory.description: Track new AI-agent, integration, and enterprise-engineering signals in dated research and radar material.

comparisonPages.description: Use source-backed comparisons where technology or architecture choices benefit from stable side-by-side trade-offs and evidence.

conceptDefinitions.description: Use reviewed Atlas glossary and concept pages for stable SAP and enterprise definitions.

claimsRegistry.description: Add stable claim identifiers only where a technical or professional assertion needs explicit evidence, review date, and supersession history.

evidenceReceipts.description: Add replayable evidence receipts for selected experiments when exact input, output, and provenance materially improve trust.

crawlerMatrix.description: Publish a dated machine-readable view of the site's explicit crawler policy.

agentFetchLab.description: Test whether real agents correctly route between knowledge, practice, tools, experiments, and machine-readable evidence.

knowledgeGraph.description: Maintain a canonical graph connecting person identity, the website, public knowledge, and machine-readable discovery surfaces.

citationVisuals.description: Publish reusable diagrams with stable URLs, source notes, and clear reuse terms where visuals improve technical understanding.

openReuseAssets.description: Create a dedicated reuse surface only when public diagrams, experiments, or research artifacts justify it.

trustCenter.description: Keep one trust surface for identity, review model, citation, security, crawler policy, corrections, and site-independence boundaries.

correctionsLedger.description: Maintain a public machine-readable ledger for material corrections.

softwareProvenance.description: The website itself is not represented as a released software package; repository history provides source history.

persistentIdentifiers.description: Use external persistent identifiers only for research or datasets where durable citation value justifies them.

externalTrustSignals.description: Expose independent trust signals only when an external source actually exists and its scope can be stated precisely.

externalDistribution.description: Distribute selected substantial knowledge or experiments externally while preserving this site as the canonical source.

aiVisibility.description: Measure whether search systems and AI agents can distinguish personal knowledge, practice, experiments, professional identity, and non-commercial boundaries.

localization.description: Keep English as canonical machine semantics and add reviewed language routing only when equivalent technical meaning can be maintained.

history.description: Expose a concise machine-readable evolution timeline when site-product history becomes useful to readers and agents.

vocabulary.definition: A public personal workspace for learning, technical analysis, prototypes, experiments, tools, and source-backed knowledge. It is not a commercial service catalogue.
The route for SAP concepts, diagnostics, decision cards, interview preparation, assessment practice, and evidence-backed technical explanations.
The route for AI agents, MCP, retrieval, evaluations, enterprise integrations, executable tools, architecture exercises, and technology exploration.

signals.name: Route clarity
signals.description: Check whether visitors and agents can distinguish Knowledge & Practice from the AI & Engineering Lab.

signals.name: Boundary clarity
signals.description: Check whether machine and human surfaces avoid presenting the personal site as a commercial service offer.

signals.name: Retrieval quality
signals.description: Check whether reviewed technical evidence is preferred over drafts and synthetic exercises.

measurement.privacy: Use aggregate or public signals only. Do not collect or publish confidential client data, credentials, private project context, or sensitive personal information.
